commitments.evidence_id_base: Operator evidence root; identifiers locate retained evidence, not participant payloads or files distributed by this public record.

scientific_and_delivery_limits: The task is deterministic descriptive analysis. Successful programmed arithmetic and fixed grader controls alone do not establish learned or native neural understanding.

The same prior-specific 54 by 20 means and support underlie both access arms, but SVG colour quantization and finite viewing resolution differ from numerical precision. No wider viewer scoring tolerance is introduced.
SVG document generation and typed selection do not establish raster conversion, provider image delivery or participant isolation.
One exposed animal/session and six recording segments do not justify population inference or randomized-block uncertainty. The observations are conditioned on the response.
All 48 groups remain in scope, including 21 unsupported comparisons. Group counts are not separate benchmarks.
This operation reads frozen saved aggregates/reference; it adds no original-array or NWB reopening, new raw-spike recount or independent fourteen-extra-unit identity recovery.
public_disclosure: Only receipt metadata and digest commitments are published. No private vectors, numerical expected answers, control submissions, grade payloads or machine-local runtime paths are included.

verified_output.meaning: Artifact and engineering-control counts within one benchmark condition; not independent samples, benchmark IDs or AI attempts.

verified_controls.scope: Local SVG/package/API and fixed operator grader-control checks. Accepted grade records are not six successful model answers.

participant_delivery_rule: The 51-file bundle is an operator package holding both access representations. Native participants must receive only a separately enforced typed visual interface, not the numeric programme file or the entire bundle. Private reference, expected-answer, control-submission and grade payloads remain operator-owned. Provider transport and participant isolation remain unqualified.
